test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ₹10,415 is divided among P, Q, and R in such a way that if ₹62, ₹17, and ₹79 are deducted from their respective shares, they have money in the ratio 15:10:14. Find the difference between the original shares of Q and R.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

After deduction ⇒ ratio = 15 : 10 : 14

Let shares = 15x, 10x, 14x

Original total ⇒ (15x+62)+(10x+17)+(14x+79)=10415

⇒ 39x + 158 = 10415 ⇒ x = 263

**∴ Difference = (14x+79) − (10x+17) = 1114**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = 10415

Deductions: P = 62, Q = 17, R = 79

Ratio after deduction = 15 : 10 : 14

**Formula used:**

If quantities are in ratio a : b : c ⇒ values = ax, bx, cx

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let reduced shares be 15x, 10x, 14x

⇒ Original shares: P = 15x + 62, Q = 10x + 17, R = 14x + 79

⇒ Sum = (15x + 62) + (10x + 17) + (14x + 79) = 10415

⇒ 39x + 158 = 10415

⇒ 39x = 10257

⇒ x = 263

⇒ Q = 10x + 17 = 2647

⇒ R = 14x + 79 = 3761

⇒ Difference = 3761 − 2647 = 1114

**∴ The correct answer is 1114.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Adjusted Ratio Method

Assume ratio after deduction, then add constants back.

Linear Equation

Use total sum to find x.

Difference Shortcut

Difference = (ratio difference × x) adjusted with constants.
